# API Design Principles, REST Style Guide & OpenAPI Validator (2026)

> Practical API design principles handbook (44 rules, 32 automated in OpenAPI validator, backed by RFC 9110, RFC 9457, RFC 8594, RFC 9111, RFC 9700, RFC 9745, IETF Idempotency-Key, Google AIP, and OWASP API Top 10) paired with a zero-dependency OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 JSON & YAML validator, breaking-change diff checker, GitHub Action, and SARIF exporter (Verified: 2026-11-18).

## Summary
`api-design-tools/api-design-principles` turns API style rules into checks that run locally, in CI, and in the browser. It pairs a structured rule catalog (`rules.json`), five built-in presets (`presets/google-aip.json`, `presets/stripe-style.json`, `presets/owasp-api-top10.json`, `presets/strict-public-api.json`, `presets/zalando.json`), a Python 3.9+ standard-library CLI (`api_validator.py`), a composite GitHub Action (`action.yml`), and a static GitHub Pages validator (`https://api-design-tools.github.io/api-design-principles/`).

## Automated OpenAPI Rules (32 rules: ADP-001 to ADP-022, ADP-028 to ADP-030, ADP-033 to ADP-039)
- Naming & Paths (`ADP-001` to `ADP-004`, `ADP-036`, `ADP-038`): Plural resource nouns without CRUD verbs (`/v1/orders`), lowercase `kebab-case`, no trailing slashes, explicit major version prefix, declared and required path variables, PascalCase schema keys, consistent JSON casing.
- HTTP Method Semantics & Batches (`ADP-005` to `ADP-007`, `ADP-020`, `ADP-039`): `GET`/`HEAD` must never declare `requestBody`; `POST` creation returns `201` (`Location`) or `202`; `DELETE` returns `204`/`202` without required body; `PATCH` (`application/merge-patch+json`) + `ETag`/`If-Match`; `:batch` endpoints cap `maxItems <= 100` and return `207 Multi-Status`.
- Error Handling & Observability (`ADP-008`, `ADP-009`, `ADP-030`): Explicit `4xx` responses using `RFC 9457` Problem Details (`application/problem+json`) plus `X-Request-Id` or `traceparent` headers.
- Pagination, Caching & Rate Limiting (`ADP-010`, `ADP-011`, `ADP-013`, `ADP-018`, `ADP-028`): Keyset cursors over `OFFSET`, `429` + `Retry-After` + `RateLimit-*` headers, explicit `Cache-Control`/`ETag` on `GET 200`, `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers.
- Security, Schemas, Money & Documentation (`ADP-012`, `ADP-014` to `ADP-017`, `ADP-019`, `ADP-021`, `ADP-022`, `ADP-029`, `ADP-033` to `ADP-035`, `ADP-037`): `Idempotency-Key` on `POST`, `https://` servers, `securitySchemes`, no query-string secrets, `info.contact`/`license` + `tags`, bounded strings/arrays/numbers, `additionalProperties: false` on request DTOs, integer minor-unit money (`*_minor` + ISO 4217), ISO 8601 `date-time`, and structured JSON media types.

## Architecture Guidelines (12 rules: ADP-023 to ADP-027, ADP-031, ADP-032, ADP-040 to ADP-044)
- BOLA/IDOR tenant predicate scoping, prefixed ULID/UUIDv7 IDs, HMAC-SHA256 webhooks with 5-minute replay windows, `202` long-running jobs, Tolerant Reader contract evolution, OpenAPI 3.1 `webhooks`, GraphQL depth/complexity limits, Protobuf `reserved` field tags & gRPC deadlines, OAuth 2.1 PKCE + JWKS, and 6-12 month Sunset deprecation policies.

## Quick CLI & GitHub Action Usage
- Lint JSON or YAML spec: `python3 api_validator.py --spec examples/orders-api-good.openapi.yaml --preset strict-public-api`
- Breaking-change diff: `python3 api_validator.py --diff base.yaml head.yaml --format markdown`
- SARIF 2.1.0 output: `python3 api_validator.py --spec openapi.json --format sarif --output api-design.sarif`
- GitHub Action: `uses: api-design-tools/api-design-principles@v1`
